project_title: Reproducible Research Data Quality and Analysis Console
context_type: DASHBOARDS & ADMIN PANELS (Academic & Data Science Precision)
theme_strategy: Dual Mode (Light Paper Lab Journal as primary default with high-contrast Slate/Obsidian Dark mode)
data_testid_requirement: MANDATORY - All interactive and key data display elements MUST include descriptive kebab-case data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='run-r-pipeline-button', data-testid='raw-cleaned-row-comparison', data-testid='correlation-matrix-table')

font_family_pairing.headings: Cabinet Grotesk, Outfit, or Playfair Display for editorial scientific headings (Avoid standard Inter/Roboto)
font_family_pairing.body: IBM Plex Sans or DM Sans for clear statistical data reading
font_family_pairing.code_and_mono: IBM Plex Mono or JetBrains Mono for stats, p-values, R console output, and CSV previews

rules.no_flat_transparent_overlays: Never use pure transparent backgrounds for headers, dropdowns, or modals. Use backdrop-blur-md with 85%+ opacity surface color.

layout_and_spacing.grid_strategy: High-Density Data Grid (MODE B) with 1px border grid dividers
layout_and_spacing.shadows: shadow-sm border border-border for clean lab notebook feel

key_components_structure.name: Header & Execution Bar
key_components_structure.description: Features prominent title, 'All data is SYNTHETIC' disclaimer pill, R Analysis execution trigger button with live loading state, and dark/light toggle.

key_components_structure.name: Data Validation & Audit Panel
key_components_structure.description: Displays automated R janitor/tidyverse validation metrics: missing values, duplicate rows, data type mismatches, and invalid ranges.

key_components_structure.name: Raw vs Cleaned Dataset Comparison
key_components_structure.description: Interactive split preview of raw imported CSV vs cleaned R dataset with row count differences and filter tabs.

key_components_structure.name: Descriptive Statistics & Frequency Tables
key_components_structure.description: Publication-ready summary tables (Mean, SD, Median, IQR, Min, Max) and categorical distributions.

key_components_structure.name: Correlation Matrix & Statistical Inference
key_components_structure.description: Interactive Pearson/Spearman correlation matrix with p-value significance callouts (e.g., r = 0.64, p < 0.001).

key_components_structure.name: Publication Figure Gallery (ggplot2 Outputs)
key_components_structure.description: Displays high-resolution publication-quality ggplot2 figures rendered directly by R (PNGs) with captions and download options.

key_components_structure.name: Automated Test Runner & Reproducible Report
key_components_structure.description: Panel showing R testthat execution status, embedded/external link to rendered R Markdown HTML report, and real R console log terminal.

motion_and_interaction.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion with instant fallback transitions
motion_and_interaction.micro_interactions: Smooth button hover fill, subtle count-up on numeric stats, fade-in for R script pipeline outputs

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the web UI connects to real R script execution endpoints (FastAPI backend executing Rscript or knitr/Rmarkdown).
Ensure all data-testid attributes listed in key_components_structure are applied in .js / .jsx code.
Do NOT use pure transparent backgrounds for floating headers or dropdowns.
Format tables with clear borders, tabular font numbers (font-mono), and crisp header contrast.
Display prominent banner confirming 'All dataset records are 100% synthetic for academic research demonstration'.
